title: Settings-panel hit-test semantics now live in THREE hand-synced copies — the parity twin forks the documented ONE-copy delegation pattern
detail: The repo pattern is one shared input-package hit proc (popover_demolish_hit). The settings panel instead hand-mirrors open/close/row-focus in the harness (and again in settings_click vs apply_intent). A future settings_click edit silently diverges from parity — the drift class the pattern prevents.
recommended_fix: Move chip/row hit + panel_open/panel_row mutations into one app/input proc (state is already input-owned; on_settings/on_settings_adjust hooks exist); app click and parity hook both delegate to it.

title: still present since round 1: all 25 parity scenarios run only at defaults — never under any a11y mode or scale
evidence:
harness/parity.odin:174-184: "view: rnd.View
view.catalogs = cat // the render package reads the catalogs (tray chip count/rects)
pal := rnd.palette_load()
view.palette = &pal
rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)" || app/render/view.odin:106-107: "if v.ui_scale <= 0 {
	v.ui_scale = 1.0
}" || grep ui_scale|reduced_motion|palette_apply_mode over harness/parity.odin: zero matches — every drive runs ui_scale=1.0, motion on, palette Off.
detail: "Full input parity holds under every a11y mode" is construction-argued only. ui_scale moves hit rects (settings chip width is mode-dependent), so the ×1.50 input leg is the real untested risk.
recommended_fix: Drive the parity matrix once at ×1.50 (plus one palette mode and reduced-motion leg), or add a scaled-rect parity scenario asserting identical end-states per device.

title: Machado matrices + 48/40 thresholds duplicated between derive_a11y_palettes.py and the palcheck oracle with no committed cross-check
detail: The CVD model lives in two languages. A severity/matrix edit in the script leaves the oracle silently simulating the wrong deficiency; the r1 'script emits shipped tables' check was manual, not committed.
recommended_fix: Commit a cross-check (test asserting the script's emitted modes block + matrices match the shipped palette.json/palcheck constants), or source both from one data file.

title: The 5 a11y demos are verbatim juice.dem scene copies — 6 hand-synced copies of the juice scene, no derivation
evidence:
demos/a11y_deutan.dem:8-14: "seed 7
run 70000ms
era 3
fixture off
spawn_node residential 4 6
spawn_node residential 7 12" ... demos/a11y_deutan.dem:36-40: "at 100ms draw 6 10 narrow
at 100ms emphasis 7 express_heavy
at 100ms emphasis 2 best_effort_heavy
capture at 30000ms" — diff of non-comment lines vs demos/juice.dem differs ONLY in line 1 ('a11y palette deutan') for all five a11y demos (verified mechanically).
detail: A future juice.dem scene edit does not propagate; each copy's golden silently pins a stale scene while the 'same scene under each mode' claim erodes. Six hand-synced copies of ~28 verb lines.
recommended_fix: Either add a small 'base <demo>' include verb to the parser, or a lint/check that diffs the a11y copies' verb lines against juice.dem.

title: Demo.a11y_palette u8 duplicates Palette_Mode's implicit ordinals — unpinned numeric coupling across packages
detail: The parser writes literals 1/2/3; the harness casts the raw u8 to the enum. Inserting/reordering a Palette_Mode member silently remaps demo verbs to the wrong mode; nothing pins the ordinals.
recommended_fix: Pin the mapping in a unit test (Palette_Mode(1) == .Deutan etc.), or export a name→mode helper from app/render and map at apply time.

evidence: tools/ci-local.sh:56: "  \"Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && odin test app -out:bin/app-test && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test\"" — header comment at line 48-50: "# One entry per GH CI run step (workflow order + workflow step names)."
detail: Gate 2 now runs core + app + app/render + harness tests (205+12+11+2), but the label — which mirrors the GitHub workflow step name — still describes core-only coverage.
recommended_fix: Relabel gate 2 to e.g. 'Unit tests (core + app + render + harness)' and sync the GH workflow step name when billing unblocks.

title: still present since round 1: palcheck picks the 40-vs-48 threshold by pr[0] color-value equality, not pair identity
detail: If a future mode edit sets a signal token to a map token's exact value, that pair silently falls under the looser map threshold — the oracle weakens itself.
recommended_fix: Key the threshold on the pair's token indices (build pairs as (token_a, token_b, threshold) tuples) rather than comparing color values.

title: still present since round 1: spec-7-3 doc drift — intent names, 0.99 motion pin, comma demo verb
evidence: spec line 65: "- `app/input/types.odin` + `poll/controller/touch` -- new Intents (Settings_Toggle, Panel_Navigate, Panel_Activate, Scale_Step); mapped on all devices" || spec line 67: "- `harness/demo.odin` -- `a11y <mode>[,<mode>]` demo verb" || spec line 106: "- Reduced-motion static value: a fixed mid-envelope factor (e.g. 0.99) — deterministic, golden-stable;" — shipped: Toggle_Settings/Settings_Navigate/Settings_Activate; parser grammar 'a11y palette|reduced|scale'; motion pinned full-static 1.0.
detail: The frozen spec contradicts the shipped names, the shipped full-static pin, and the shipped parser grammar — future maintainers read three wrong contracts.
